sounds._arrangement: 64 beats: A; A2 with the tune on clarinet under a flute counter-line; B in F on marimba; a breakdown that brings the shaker back in its last bar.
64 beats: A; A2 with the tune on trumpet and a kick and snare joining the band; a trio in B flat; a breakdown with a tambourine build.

sounds._about: Menu move: a soft wicker-basket tap.
Menu select: an egg settling into the basket with a kalimba note.
Menu back: a soft wicker thud.
Pause music: pizzicato and a clarinet, an easy spring stroll.

_score: The meadow's score: the title tune's harmony always plays; the rhythm joins as rounds go on, the tune and a counter-line as the streak grows; a pizzicato drive in the last ten seconds and a low tremolo when one basket is left.
